# VEDICA - Inbal Hanasab Ayurveda Clinic in Tel Aviv

> VEDICA offers personal Ayurveda consultations with Inbal Hanasab (ענבל הנסב) in Tel Aviv, in Hebrew or English. The clinic provides complementary support for sensitive digestion, sleep, stress, perimenopause, menopause and fertility alongside existing medical care.

Updated: 2026-11-07.

The clinic is at Merhavim Clinic, Arlozorov 82, Tel Aviv, Israel. Inbal is the founder and owner of VEDICA, a certified Ayurveda practitioner, a graduate of PranaVeda School of Ayurveda and a member of the Association for the Promotion of Ayurvedic Medicine in Israel. Her approach combines Ayurveda with traditional Persian-Iranian food and herbal knowledge.

The consultation process starts with two meetings. The first meeting lasts 1.5–2 hours and includes detailed intake and traditional pulse diagnosis. The second meeting lasts 1 hour and presents a personalized plan for nutrition, daily routine, infusions and herbs when appropriate. Optional follow-up and questions between sessions support implementation. Fees are available by enquiry; ask about suitability, appointment availability and the fee for the two meetings before booking.

Care is planned alongside medical, mental-health and fertility care, including IVF. Current medications, diagnoses and relevant blood tests are reviewed before herbs are recommended. Public guides provide general information, not medical diagnosis or a substitute for medical care. The clinic does not advise stopping prescribed medication or medical follow-up, and does not promise cures or fertility outcomes.

Also offers 45–60 minute wellness lectures and group workshops in Hebrew or English. Educational experiences, not individual medical consultations.
- [Corporate Ayurveda and wellness in Tel Aviv — English](https://vedica-ayurveda.co.il/corporate-ayurveda-wellness-tel-aviv.html): English information for HR, employee experience teams and international companies about the same two-hour Ayurveda tasting stand, wellness talks and group workshops with Inbal. Herbal infusions, spices, food traditions and everyday ideas, in English or Hebrew. Tastings and explanations only; no product sales. Event size and pricing by agreement. Includes past Indian Embassy event photos and an English quote enquiry form.
- [Levinsky Market tours - Hebrew](https://vedica-ayurveda.co.il/tours.html): Shared or private tasting and spice tours with Inbal in Hebrew or English, about two hours. Meet at Aluf Batslut Alley, a hidden green spot amid bustling Tel Aviv. Start with artisan sourdough breads, dates and market produce, taste refreshing Persian falooda, and explore spice origins, ingredient shops and practical ways to use ingredients in everyday meals. Ayurveda and Persian-Iranian heritage connect the food, market communities and Silk Road stories. An infusion and a personal herb and spice kit are included. Finish with lunch recommendations; lunch is purchased separately. Additional tastings and stops can be tailored to the group by prior arrangement. WhatsApp for dates and direct booking; GetYourGuide is also available.
- [Levinsky Market Tasting & Spice Tour with Inbal - English](https://vedica-ayurveda.co.il/levinsky-market-food-tour.html): Shared or private tasting and spice tours with Inbal in Hebrew or English, about two hours.
